text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no!
Don't make that face, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine, yep!
So cheer up too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I just have to do my best next time!
Carrotman always says that as long as you don't give up, the future is bright!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
